description.p: neoglogg is a multi-platform GUI application to browse and search through long or complex log files. It is designed with programmers and system administrators in mind, and can be seen as a graphical, interactive combination of grep and less.

Files are streamed from disk rather than loaded into memory, so very large logs open immediately. Searches run across all available processor cores and the results appear in a second pane that stays in sync with the main view. The log file is only ever opened read-only.

ul.li: Parallel search across all processor cores
Automatic encoding detection: UTF-8, UTF-16, CP1251, CP1252, Big5, GB18030, ISO-8859-1, Shift_JIS and KOI8-R
Highlighting filters, marks and a file overview

description.p: This is a maintained fork of glogg by Nicolas Bonnefon, updated and upgraded.
First release of the fork: ported to Qt 6, with parallel search, line wrapping, a dark theme, line-range searching, multi-file opening and new icons.
